about.headline: A Cleveland body shop that still answers the phone.
about.body: Harden Auto Body, Inc. is a family-owned collision shop serving greater Cleveland from South Euclid, close to Mayfield and Green. Over 250 years of combined experience sits on the shop floor. We repair what you drive, guarantee the work for as long as you own the car (excluding normal wear), and keep rentals simple with Enterprise on-site. Email hardenab@yahoo.com or call the shop direct.
